## Overview

Principal Investigator on a competitively awarded **HEC National Research Programme
for Universities (NRPU) project (2026–2028)**, conducted by UMT in partnership with
King Edward Medical University and Mayo Hospital, Lahore. The project is building an
expert-annotated prostate cancer histopathology dataset and an AI-based diagnostic
tool for Gleason grading and perineural invasion detection.

This project has just started — more details, methods, and results will be added
here as the work progresses.

See the [Research Statement](../../research.qmd) page for broader context.
